package socketauthority

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

func researchSocketBuffer(packet net.PacketConn) {
	conn, ok := packet.(*net.UDPConn)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	requested, _ := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("WS_WAN_RCVBUF"))
	var setError string
	if requested > 0 {
		if err := conn.SetReadBuffer(requested); err != nil {
			setError = err.Error()
		}
	}
	actual := 0
	var readError string
	raw, err := conn.SyscallConn()
	if err != nil {
		readError = err.Error()
	} else {
		err = raw.Control(func(fd uintptr) {
			value, queryErr := syscall.GetsockoptInt(int(fd), syscall.SOL_SOCKET, syscall.SO_RCVBUF)
			actual = value
			if queryErr != nil {
				readError = queryErr.Error()
			}
		})
		if err != nil {
			readError = err.Error()
		}
	}
	// Linux may clamp and double requests; record the kernel's effective value.
	record, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"timeMs": time.Now().UnixMilli(), "address": conn.LocalAddr().String(),
		"requestedBytes": requested, "actualBytes": actual, "setError": setError, "readError": readError,
	})
	file, err := os.OpenFile("research-socket-buffer-"+os.Args[1]+".ndjson", os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0600)
	if err == nil {
		_, _ = file.Write(append(record, '\n'))
		_ = file.Close()
	}
}
